- Chỉ các scope Owner đang trực tiếp giữ bằng private chat/`00`/`01` mới bị loại khỏi autonomous mutation.
- Ngoài các reserved Owner scopes đó, Control Plane được self-heal bằng repair owner độc lập; không được để toàn hệ thống IDLE chỉ vì thiếu Owner/Vy prompt.
- Core vẫn là selector/dispatcher; NV02 là owner-proxy executor; Coding Lane/NV API là repair/review pool.
- Actor không tự sửa chính runtime/controller mình đang sở hữu; phải handoff độc lập.
- Production/paid/credential-security/destructive/irreversible vẫn fail-closed.

- Canonical policy: Interaction #504 v33.

- NV02/App Chrome tuyệt đối không tự duyệt backlog/chọn P0/chọn job; chỉ execute/continue/F5 job đã được giao.

- F5 NV02 ngẫu nhiên 5–10 phút là health probe độc lập; không điều kiện theo UI state và không tạo duplicate prompt.

- `NV02 = ChatGPT Plus` — primary UI executor; `GPT-6 Astra` là resource on-demand của NV02.

- Registry #335 v52 is the current workforce/capability authority; provider identities must be read from Registry rather than copied from stale snapshots.
- Interaction #504 v31 là generic command policy; explicit Owner instruction có thể supersede scoped delegation.

## CORE/API AUTONOMY HIERARCHY — Owner directive 2026-09-18
- MANAGER: decompose/select acceptance.
- EXECUTOR: mutate/execute within scoped lease.
- REVIEWER: independent resource; cannot approve own implementation.
- REPAIR_SUPERVISOR: on eligible FAIL/BLOCKED/CI/review/stall, perform RCA → durable repair generation → retest; no Owner/chat checkpoint between safe cycles.
- GATE: deterministic authority/evidence gate. Escalate only Production outside current scoped authorization, paid, credential/security, destructive/irreversible, physical action, conflicting Owner intent, or real external blocker.
- Canonical implementation work: #922 - Autonomous Repair Supervisor v2.
- APP Chrome remains isolated under #876; Core/API automation must not mutate `apps/worker-utility/**`.

## QUEUE PRIORITY POLICY
`OWNER_DIRECT → P0 → P1 → P2 → P3`.
- Một Work Order/resource scope chỉ có một active mutation owner.
- Không hai nhánh cùng mutation một resource.
- Blocker thật thì checkpoint; lane độc lập an toàn mới được tiếp tục.
- Không bypass credential/security/paid/Production/destructive/irreversible gates.

## CHAT LIVENESS
- `CHAT_LIVENESS_POLICY=#504_V31`: tác vụ dài phải checkpoint-first, báo trạng thái trước bước có khả năng chặn; spinner/loading không phải bằng chứng chạy nền; NEW CHAT resume từ authoritative checkpoint gần nhất.

## GOVERNANCE
- Không direct `main`; merge chỉ sau exact-head required checks đạt.
- Production/runtime deploy, paid action, credential/security change, destructive/irreversible action cần authorization riêng.
- Không claim live/DONE nếu thiếu runtime/reviewer evidence cần thiết.

OWNER_RUNTIME_RULE_UPDATE — COPY_OUTPUT_ONE_LINE_V1

Effective immediately for new chats and Auto Chat `1` sessions:
- Any content intended for direct copy/paste must be presented in ONE compact line by default: Prompt, PowerShell, CMD, Bash, code snippet, JSON payload, command, URL bundle, config fragment, or similar copy artifact.
- Do not wrap into multiple lines unless the syntax would break or the user explicitly requests multiline formatting.
- For Prompt requests, preserve the existing TigerIQ rule: exactly one Copy prompt beginning `LÀM — NO YAPPING.`
- For PowerShell/CMD/console content, keep command text ASCII/no Vietnamese diacritics where console compatibility matters.
- Prefer one complete executable command over a sequence of manual commands.
- If multiple manual actions are unavoidable, consolidate them into one final Owner Action batch instead of interrupting execution.

State: ACTIVE / applies to future chat contexts through CENTRAL runtime rules.

## UX POLICY — SINGLE PAYLOAD OUTPUT — 2026-09-08
Owner requirement: when TigerIQ/Vy provides CODE, CMD, PowerShell, JSON, scripts, prompts, migration commands, or other copy/paste execution payloads, output must be packaged as **one single copy block** by default.

Rules:
- Never dump a sequence of separate commands/blocks across multiple messages when they can be safely bundled.
- Prefer **one self-contained command/script/prompt** that performs the whole safe scope.
- If multiple steps are technically unavoidable, keep them inside **one code block**, in executable order, with minimal outside explanation.
- For prompts: exactly **one prompt block**, beginning `LÀM — NO YAPPING.`
- For CMD/PowerShell/code/JSON/text: exactly **one copy block** unless the user explicitly asks for alternatives or separate files.
- Before presenting payload, audit whether the requested action can be consolidated; consolidate first.
- Do not make the Owner repeatedly ask for the next fragment because the first response was incomplete.
- If a manual interaction is genuinely unavoidable, state that once, at the top, and give the smallest possible manual action.

This is a dynamic UX/operational policy within the existing NO-YAPPING and source-of-truth envelope; it does not change core safety or authorization boundaries.
